text_block_list.text:
I came to check on how
Mejiro Palmer's dance lesson was going, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Waaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaay! Whoo~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yo, yo!
Trainer-san, 'sup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I was slacking off, you know?
I was just catching my breath for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, Palmer was feeling down so I partied it up?
Thanks to that, high vibes! Feelin' so hyped, whoo-hoo☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing big,
I'm just having trouble memorizing the choreography.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The song I'm practicing right now is insanely difficult,
so I keep making mistake after mistake.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'll have it sorted out before dancing on stage,
so don't worry, it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I guess it's about time
to wrap up my break.
choice_data_list: Don't overthink it. Just have fun dancing like you were earlier!
Let's think about what the choreography means together

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Have fun?
choice_data_list: It was great to feel so free.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Dancing is all about vibes and feeling!
Getting hype is number one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Maybe I was choking myself up
by obsessing over dancing perfectly."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! Don't worry about mistakes,
just lighten up and dance! Way to go!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The vibes are totally maxed out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I think I'm dancing even better
than I was before taking a break!
And so, Mejiro Palmer rediscovered the joy of dancing and overcame her reluctance toward it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—I see. Every single part of the choreography
really does have a meaning behind it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In that case, before memorizing the choreography,
if I can properly understand the song...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wanna hit up karaoke for now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gotcha! If you wanna understand the lyrics,
singing it is the best way!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaay! We gotta go for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Waaaay! Trainer, come with us!

Afterward, Mejiro Palmer deepened her
understanding of the song and mastered the dance.
